candidate_description: Ordinary learned projection adapter plus S+ temporal-window mass loss, lambda=0.1. Existing selected windows only; outside frames are not newly labeled absent. Not claimed novel.
diagnostic_gate: On both final-epoch and seen-selected best diagnostic checkpoints, at least one joint probe passes the preregistered readout gain and joint-over-unimodal gates. This is association support only, not causal proof.
candidate_gate_failure: Skip unsupported window candidate, finish simple controls and report negative or limited mechanism evidence.
development_selection: Choose strongest simple control using pseudo dev AUROC among controls with seen AUROC loss <=0.01. Formal candidate enabled only with >=0.03 pseudo AUROC gain, seen loss <=0.01, and pseudo FRR/RR degradation <=0.03 relative to strongest simple control. No true U data or predictions read before selection.
formal_matrix: All simple controls at seed 3407 across five groups/three GMR backbones and five groups/QD+Flash positive-only VTG. Supported candidate, if development gate passes, uses only seed 3407. No multi-seed experiments.
batch_rule: Independent CPU torch.Generator(seed); full permutation each epoch, no drop_last. Identical within backbone/split/track/seed across methods. Development canonical baseline rerun included because historic diagnostic loader used global RNG.
historical_flash_scheduler: Preserve original StepLR.step(last batch loss) behavior; report explicitly rather than silently repairing it.
calibration_control: Monotone sigmoid affine fit on seen validation only, 100 full-batch Adam updates, positive slope enforced; recorded separately as validation-fit exposures. Does not alter original official gate.
test_selection: All model family/hyperparameter/seed/threshold selection frozen before any formal true U test prediction. Test outputs never feed scheduling or selection.
teacher_controls: Skipped: CLIP projection provenance and same-information budget gate unverified; no new teacher information.
failure_policy: One automatic retry in a new attempt directory; preserve failures; continue independent tasks. No model/evaluation result marked successful on missing artifacts or failed budget audit.
single_seed_constraint: User explicitly disabled all multi-seed runs; only 3407 is authorized.
